title.en: Where Did the Donkey Come From?

setting.or: ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଲୋକକଥାର ଗାଁବାଟ ଓ ବାଟୋଇଙ୍କ ବିଶ୍ରାମ ସ୍ଥାନ। ଅବୋଲକରା ଓ ତାଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନୀ ମାଲିକଙ୍କ ଚରିତ୍ର ପାରମ୍ପରିକ; ଏହି ପର୍ବର ଘଟଣା ଓ ସଂଳାପ ଏହି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପର ନୂଆ ରଚନା। କୌଣସି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଲେଖକଙ୍କ ଗପର ଅନୁବାଦ ନୁହେଁ। ସାଆନ୍ତ ଏଠାରେ ସମ୍ବୋଧନ, ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ନାମ ନୁହେଁ। ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀ, ଗାଁ, ଜାତି ବା ଅବୋଲକରାର ବୟସ ଧାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ହୋଇନାହିଁ।
setting.en: Village paths and travellers’ resting places in a folktale Odisha. Abolakara and his learned master are traditional figures; the events and dialogue of this episode are newly written for this project, not a translation of a particular author’s story. Saanta is a form of address here, not a personal name. No exact century, village, caste or age for Abolakara is assigned.

wardrobe.or: ପୂର୍ବ ଚରିତ୍ର ଅଧ୍ୟୟନ ସହ ମେଳ: ଅବୋଲକରାର ସରୁ ଦେହ, ଅସଜଡ଼ା କେଶ, ସାଧା ହଳଦିଆ ଛୋଟ ହାତର ଜାମା, ଆଣ୍ଠୁ ପାଖେ ଖୋସା କ୍ରିମ୍ ଧୋତି, ଡାହାଣ କାନ୍ଧରେ ନୀଳ କପଡ଼ା ଓ ଚପଲ। ସାଆନ୍ତଙ୍କ ପାଚିଆ ପତଳା କେଶ, ଛୋଟ ନିଶ, କ୍ରିମ୍ ଜାମା, ଲମ୍ବା ଧୋତି ଓ ବାମ କାନ୍ଧରେ ସରୁ ଧାରର ଚାଦର। ବସିବାବେଳେ ଧୋତିର କୁଞ୍ଚ ବଦଳିବ; କାନ୍ଧର ପଟ ବଦଳିବନି। ଗୋଟିଏ ପୁଟୁଳି, ଗୋଟିଏ ଆସନ ଓ ଗୋଟିଏ ବାଉଁଶ ବେଣ୍ଟର ଛତା। ପୋଷାକ ଏହି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା; ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ କାଳର ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ପୁନର୍ନିର୍ମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
wardrobe.en: Continue the earlier character study: lean, unruly-haired Abolakara in a plain ochre short-sleeved top, cream dhoti tucked near the knees, blue cloth over his anatomical right shoulder and sandals. Saanta has thinning grey hair, a small moustache, a cream short-sleeved top, long dhoti and a narrow-bordered cloth over his anatomical left shoulder. Seated folds change; shoulder sides do not. One bundle, one mat and one bamboo-handled umbrella. These are project interpretations, not authenticated reconstructions of a particular period.

continuity.or: ଦୁହେଁ ଛାଇରେ ବସି ରହିବେ; କୁମ୍ଭାର, ପିଲା, ହାଣ୍ଡି ବା ଗଧ ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଆସିବେନି। ସାଆନ୍ତଙ୍କ ହାତର ଭଙ୍ଗୀ ଓ ମୁହଁରେ ଗପ ରହିବ। ଏକ ପୁଟୁଳି, ଏକ ଖୋଲା ଆସନ ଓ ଏକ ବନ୍ଦ ଛତା ସ୍ଥିର ଜାଗାରେ।
continuity.en: Both remain seated in shade. Do not draw the potter, child, pot or donkey. The tale lives in Saanta’s gestures and expressions. One bundle, one unrolled mat and one closed umbrella remain in fixed places.

performance.or: ଗପରେ ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ → ଅନ୍ୟ ଗପ ମିଶିଯିବା → ଭୁଲ୍ ଧରି ହସିବା → ସଠିକ୍ ଶେଷକୁ ଫେରିବା।
performance.en: Confident storytelling → mixing up two tales → laughing at his slip → returning to the right ending.

observations: Abolakara remains screenleft and Saanta screenright, both cross-legged on one woven mat in tree shade. No exact age, century, village or caste is assigned.
Preserve the older cast’s ink-and-wash faces and less rounded proportions; do not import the Young Makers child faces.

Abolakara: plain ochre short-sleeved top, cream dhoti tucked near knees, blue cloth on anatomical RIGHT shoulder, sandals. Saanta: thinning grey hair, small grey moustache, cream short-sleeved top, long dhoti, narrow-bordered cloth on anatomical LEFT shoulder.
Keep the blue cloth and bordered cloth on their correct anatomical shoulders throughout gestures; do not treat shading as textile patterns.
One brown bundle left of Abolakara, one woven mat beneath both, one closed dark umbrella with bamboo handle right of Saanta. No duplicate mat roll or shoulder bundle when seated.
Standing cast informs identity; seated storyboard informs folds and staging. Generate coherent seated sources, not vertically compressed standing drawings.
No drawn donkey, pot, potter or child. Six dialogue lines and hand mime carry the story.
First pot-shaping gesture uses two hands; later one-hand narration, recall/upward glance, shared smile and imaginary pouring gesture. Avoid new waving motion unrelated to the script.
The four-panel storyboard shifts framing and background slightly; use one fixed background and preserve prop/feet positions through the film.
Use connected shoulder sources or correctly overlapped arm layers to avoid open sleeve sockets. Avoid transparent whole-arm crossfades and collapsing linear trajectories through an elbow.

text.or: କୁମ୍ଭାର ଭାବିଲା, ହାଣ୍ଡିଟା ଫାଟିଛି। ପାଣି ଭରିଲେ ତଳୁ ବାହାରିଯାଉଛି।
text.en: The potter thought his pot was cracked. Whenever he filled it, water ran out below.

text.or: ଆରେ, ସେ ଆଉ ଗୋଟେ ଗପରେ! ଏଠି ତ ଛୋଟ ପିଲାଟିଏ ଥିଲା।
text.en: Oh, that belongs to another story! There was a small child in this one.

text.or: ପିଲାଟି କହିଲା, “ହାଣ୍ଡି ଫାଟିନି। ତୁମେ ବାହାରେ ଢାଳୁଛ!”
text.en: The child said, “The pot isn’t cracked. You’re pouring outside it!”

text.or: ଆଜି ତୁମ ଗପ ବି ଟିକେ ବାହାରେ ପଡ଼ିଲା।
text.en: Your story spilled a little outside today too.

productionPlan: Create fixed tree-shade setting, one mat and two consistent seated character sources.
Test pot-shaping hands, interrupting head tilt, recall glance and pouring mime with steady seated feet and props.
Retain six exact paired lines and original quiet leaf/cloth sound; no recorded laugh or voice can be claimed.
Render and review full58-second draft, captions and phone layout; connect profile, script, wardrobe and development package.
sourceLimitation: Traditional Abolakara/master framework retained and attributed; this episode is newly written, not a translation of a named author’s story. Wardrobe is an interpreted folktale setting, not an authenticated period reconstruction.
pending: Recorded acting, final mouth/laugh performance and independent fluent/cultural review. No new service signup or purchase authorized.
